purpose: Define preservation of source classification, lineage and privacy constraints when data is copied, summarized or derived into memory.

topics.name: Memory Classification and Lineage
topics.purpose: Define preservation of source classification, lineage and privacy constraints when data is copied, summarized or derived into memory.

semantics.lineage_rule: Memory derived from governed data retains source lineage refs.
semantics.classification_rule: Memory classification propagates from source according to explicit policy.
semantics.summary_rule: Summarization does not implicitly declassify source information.
semantics.multi_source_rule: Memory derived from multiple sources uses explicit classification join semantics.
semantics.declassification_rule: Lowering classification requires an explicit authorized declassification/sanitization boundary.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote/external source lineage remains distinguishable from local memory identity.
semantics.redaction_rule: Retrieval projection may redact content while internal lineage remains preserved.

invariants.rule: Memory and retrieved context are provenance-bearing inert data projections; remembered or retrieved content never becomes authority, canonical truth or executable instruction merely by inclusion in context.

hard_gates.condition: source lineage erased after memory write

prose.summary: Define preservation of source classification, lineage and privacy constraints when data is copied, summarized or derived into memory.
